old_feature_difference: P_inc_7d is sum; P7 is exactly sum/7 over same fixed window; no old feature reused or changed

models.M1: R1 frozen monthly + W1/W7/W30; no refit

target_baseline: reuse R1 target monthly means; residual y_train-C_target
meteorological_transform: training anchor-month means, then train anomaly std(ddof=0); dev only applies
q_transform: reuse exact R1 monthly means and std; never reestimate model transform
diagnostic_warning: condition>30 or VIF>10; descriptive only, no model change
nonnegative: max(raw,0), report clipping and untruncated RMSE
exante_strata: training U(t-1) Q20/Q90, real aligned fixed date masks
orthogonal_blocks: nonoverlap30days anchored Jan1, yearend5days; restricted support intersects original blocks

year_swap.leap_rule: actual donor calendar; no target Feb29; donor Feb29 naturally enters trailing window
year_swap.replace: only upstream W1/W7/W30; target P7/T7 unchanged, frozen M3 parameters

uncertainty.type: paired within-year circular block bootstrap plus noncircular sensitivity
